data.one_liner: Generates and parses RFC‑4122/9562 UUIDs (v1‑v8) for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to create version‑1,‑4,‑5,‑6,‑7 and‑8 UUIDs and to validate or parse 128‑bit hexadecimal strings. Works on all Dart platforms with cryptographically strong RNG by default.
use_when: You need unique identifiers across devices or services
You require support for newer UUID versions (v6‑v8) or strict RFC validation
avoid_when: You need a UUID library with built‑in persistence or database integration
You prefer a code‑gen based solution for IDs
strengths: Cryptographically strong random generation on all platforms
Supports the full range of RFC‑4122 and RFC‑9562 versions
Provides explicit format validation and parsing utilities
weaknesses: Only focuses on UUID generation/parsing – no storage or networking features
No code‑generation helpers; you must call the API directly
